chunks: My father narrated, may God be pleased with him, who said: Sa'd ibn Abdullah narrated to us, who said: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa narrated to us, from Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Muhammad ibn al-Nu'man, from Al-Salam ibn al-Mustanir, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him)

Regarding the words of God, the Exalted: 'And We certainly gave Moses nine clear signs,' he said: 'The flood, the locusts, the lice, the frogs, the blood, the stone, the sea, the staff, and his hand.'
ai.seo_question: What are the nine clear signs (Ayat) that God gave to Prophet Moses according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In *Al-Khisal*, Shaykh al-Saduq records this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS), establishing the authoritative Shia interpretation of the 'nine clear signs' (Tis' Ayaat) bestowed upon Prophet Moses (AS). The list includes the flood, locusts, lice, frogs, blood, the stone (or rock), the splitting of the sea, the staff, and the shining of the hand, highlighting the comprehensive nature of divine power demonstrated during the Exodus. This tradition underscores the continuity of prophetic miracles as clear proofs (Bayyinat) for the Israelites, a theme central to Shia exegesis of the Quranic narrative of Musa.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 9-25 (The compiler of the book narrated) that his father - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Sa’ed ibn Abdullah quoted Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, on the authority of Al-Hassan ibn Mahboob, on the authority of Muhammad ibn al-Nue’man, on the authority of Salam ibn al-Mostanir, on the authority of Abi Ja’far al-Baqir (MGB)

regarding the following words of the Honorable the Exalted God, ‘To Moses We did give Nine Clear Signs’ The Imam (MGB) said, ‘They were the storm; the locusts; the lice; the frogs; the blood (in the Nile); the stone; (the splitting of) the sea (so that Israel clan could pass through it); the cane (which turned into a snake); and his hand (which shone like the moon).’”
